acceptance: Natural default CPU online load and actual production service-worker controller.
Close online page, set context offline, open new actual Word page, restore cached CPU model.
Complete requested chat with unchanged blank document.

limits: Literal operation may use deterministic tools routing; this does not establish generative factual fidelity.
